params.name: DEU_R_starmine_fix_01
params.descriptions:
Idea: Analyst estimate revisions and StarMine predicted surprise carry persistent information that the market under-reacts to. Combining three legs of the same information family (revision breadth over 12d, predicted surprise level, and 90-day revision velocity) into an equal-weight composite, then neutralizing within buckets of revision speed, isolates the slow-moving revision premium from its fast-moving confounder.

Rationale for data used: predictive_starmine is the vendor's StarMine analyst-revision dataset for DEU; mean_estimate_change_pct_f12m_earnings_14d_4 captures the 14-day consensus revision breadth for FY1 earnings, predicted_surprise_f12m_ebitda_4 the model-predicted EBITDA surprise versus consensus for the forward 12 months, and mean_estimate_change_pct_f12m_ebitda_90d_3 the slower quarterly-scale revision velocity. All three fields are MATRIX type with coverage above 0.60 and history covering the full ten-year backtest window.

Rationale for operators used: ts_mean smooths each leg to its stable information horizon (12d / 5d / 22d per leg velocity); rank equalizes units before the additive composite; the outer bucket(rank(...), range 0,1,0.05) groups stocks into 20 revision-speed decile buckets so group_neutralize removes cross-bucket speed drift, keeping only within-bucket relative conviction; 9 operators total, within the 12-operator policy.
